text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
Nationality(x, y) ::: x is of nationality y.
Club(x, y) ::: x is a football club y.
Premises:
Player(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player.
LoanedOut(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Club(nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club.
Club(braga) ::: Braga is a football club.
Club(fluimense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Nationality(ailtonSilva, brazilian) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995.
Conclusion:
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, fluimense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
